gm_headline: Nix still owns the throne, Sleeper Sux has forced its way into the top three, and 55555 is now a perfect 6-0 against the league median.

power_rankings.summary: Week 6 was modest by this roster's standards, but 125.06 was still enough for a win. Nix remains first in points scored, first in potential points, 5-1 against the median, and still owns the most complete week-to-week profile in the league.

The Week 6 loss looks more like a scoring dip than a structural problem. FantasyPros still grades Bosa as the league's strongest rest-of-season roster, while a 95.1% lineup-efficiency rate remains elite. Running-back stability is the one real crack.

Back-to-back statement weeks changed the conversation. Sleeper followed the Week 5 league high with another 155.17 in Week 6 and now owns the second-best three-week scoring average. The depth and massive FAAB edge make the contender label real.

Still the only perfect team against the weekly median. Week 6 was not pretty at 112.10, but the floor keeps holding and the 4-2 record is finally catching up to the underlying consistency. Wide receiver remains the clearest place to add ceiling.

Clutch keeps stacking actual wins, but the 2-4 median record says the margin for error is thinner than the standings suggest. Elite receiving talent still gives this roster teeth; five dollars of FAAB leaves almost no emergency lever.

The roster still grades well on talent, especially at wide receiver, but Week 6's 91.14 erased a lot of the prior momentum. CaptainJack has enough firepower to recover; the weekly floor is simply too volatile to call this a contender right now.

A 140.53-point Week 6 win finally turned roster quality into a result. The team is now exactly .500 in all-play and has strong lineup efficiency, but FantasyPros still grades the rest-of-season QB and TE rooms at the bottom of the league. Those spots cap the ceiling.

power_rankings.situation: The Record Is Doing Heavy Lifting
power_rankings.summary: Josh Allen and Jonathan Taylor keep the roster dangerous, but the production around them has cratered. A 93.00-point Week 6 and a 107.62 three-week average leave the 3-3 record looking healthier than the current scoring profile.

The backfield still has real strength, but the roster keeps failing to turn talent into points. Going Nuclear owns the league's worst lineup efficiency and only 145 FAAB remains. At 1-5, waiting for regression is no longer a plan.

There is officially no schedule defense left. Marlburrow is 0-6 head-to-head and 0-6 against the median. The roster can still steal weeks, but the playoff path now requires a near-immediate winning streak.

biggest_head_to_head_beneficiary.note: 4-2 actual despite a 2-4 median record and 53.7% all-play win rate.

biggest_head_to_head_victim.note: 4-2 actual despite a perfect 6-0 median record and 66.7% all-play win rate.

week_storylines: Eat a Bag of Nix moved to 5-1 and still leads the league in both actual points and potential points.
Sleeper Sux followed its Week 5 eruption with 155.17 in Week 6, pushing its three-week average to 159.77 and moving into the top three.
5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣ is now 6-0 against the weekly median — the league's only perfect median record.
Clutch is 4-2 head-to-head but only 2-4 versus the median; the standings are materially kinder than the underlying scoring profile.
Shake 'n Bake moved back to .500 and, under the league's PF-wildcard rule, currently occupies the sixth playoff position if the season ended today.
Marlburrow Reds is 0-6 head-to-head and 0-6 versus the median, a combined 0-12.

Eat a Bag of Nix.season_storyline: The league's most complete profile keeps banking wins even without a ceiling week.
Eat a Bag of Nix.primary_strength: elite scoring floor and roster depth
Eat a Bag of Nix.primary_weakness: depth insurance rather than a true hole
Eat a Bag of Nix.trash_talk_angle: Apparently even the quiet weeks come with a win now.

Bosa Deez Nuts.season_storyline: Still one of the league's two heavyweight rosters, but Week 6 showed it can be beaten.
Bosa Deez Nuts.primary_strength: elite WR/TE core and lineup efficiency
Bosa Deez Nuts.trash_talk_angle: The shark finally got punched in the mouth and is somehow still terrifying.

Sleeper Sux.season_storyline: Two straight monster weeks have turned a deep roster into a legitimate title threat.
Sleeper Sux.primary_strength: RB depth, recent scoring, and league-leading FAAB flexibility
Sleeper Sux.trash_talk_angle: Turns out having every running back and all the FAAB is a decent strategy.

5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣.season_storyline: The only 6-0 median team keeps winning the league field even when the box score is ugly.
5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣5️⃣.trash_talk_angle: The schedule can stop stealing credit now — this team keeps beating the room.

Clutch.season_storyline: The standings say 4-2; the 2-4 median record keeps asking uncomfortable questions.
Clutch.primary_weakness: RB stability and virtually no FAAB flexibility
Clutch.trash_talk_angle: Four wins, two median wins, five dollars left. No notes.

CaptainJack51.season_storyline: The talent remains better than the record, but volatility keeps resetting the breakout story.
CaptainJack51.primary_strength: wide receiver ceiling and strong ROS roster grade
CaptainJack51.trash_talk_angle: One week looks like a contender, the next looks like the Wi-Fi went out.

Shake 'n Bake.season_storyline: The roster finally converted a solid scoring week into a win and currently owns the PF wildcard seat.
Shake 'n Bake.trash_talk_angle: Congratulations: the good players have discovered the scoreboard.

buffalobob391.season_storyline: The record remains alive while the recent scoring profile keeps flashing warning lights.
buffalobob391.primary_strength: Josh Allen, Jonathan Taylor, and usable depth
buffalobob391.trash_talk_angle: The standings are doing more cardio than the roster.

Going Nuclear.season_storyline: There are good players here, but the lineup and production have not formed a good fantasy team.
Going Nuclear.trash_talk_angle: The reactor has plenty of fuel and somehow no electricity.

Marlburrow Reds.season_storyline: At 0-6 actual and 0-6 versus the median, the season needs a winning streak immediately.
Marlburrow Reds.trash_talk_angle: The combined record has officially entered witness-protection territory.
